args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Juniper Labware newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• The Juniper Labware newsletter highlights its 2026 warehouse automation coverage, pointing readers to a blog article and offering project-matched case studies via a companion piece.
• The article reports that autonomous carts raised warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• The companion piece adds that the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
